entities.summary: Tomiko Miyao (宮尾 登美子; April 13, 1926 – December 30, 2014) was a Japanese novelist best known for writing historical fiction. Many of her works were adapted into television dramas and films, most notably Onimasa, Atsuhime, and Yoshitsune.
